summary.zh: 中立学生不是大阵营，而是学生群体中的人员倾向。他们通常观望局势，信任度和态度会随着环境变化而摇摆。
summary.en: Neutral Students are not a major faction, but a tendency within the student body. They usually watch the situation and may shift attitude as conditions change.

items.zh: 中立学生通常不会主动冒险。
items.en: Neutral students usually avoid taking risks.

items.zh: 他们更容易受到区域支持率、组织知名度和管理层压力影响。
items.en: They are more easily influenced by regional support, faction fame, and faculty pressure.

items.zh: 态度可能随局势变化而快速转向。
items.en: Their attitude may shift quickly as the situation changes.

items.zh: 中立学生适合作为稳定扩张的主要来源。
items.en: Neutral students are a good source for steady expansion.

items.zh: 他们通常需要更明确的信任基础才会加入。
items.en: They usually need a clearer trust base before joining.

items.zh: 成功争取中立学生可以提高外围学生支持。
items.en: Winning over neutral students can raise wider student support.
